description: This file defines the FilesystemLoader class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for loading templates from the filesystem. It provides methods for managing template paths, retrieving template sources, checking existence, and path validation.

classes.name: FilesystemLoader
classes.description: A class that loads templates from the filesystem based on configured path namespaces.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Returns the list of template paths associated with a specific namespace.

methods.name: setPaths
methods.description: Sets multiple paths for a specified namespace, overwriting existing paths.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new directory to the search paths for templates within a namespace.

methods.name: prependPath
methods.description: Prepends a new directory to the search paths for templates within a namespace.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source code of a template as a Source object.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a template based on its path.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether a template exists in the registered paths.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Determines if a template is still fresh (up-to-date) relative to a given timestamp.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Locates a template file in the registered paths, optionally throwing an error if not found.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes a template name by replacing backslashes with slashes and removing duplicate slashes.

methods.name: parseName
methods.description: Parses a template name into namespace and shortname components.

methods.name: validateName
methods.description: Validates a template name ensuring it does not contain null bytes and does not attempt directory traversal.

methods.name: isAbsolutePath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is absolute.
